_comment: One unit of competency. It exists as a file because the catalogue lists a unit — and Moodle gets a grade item for it — only once this file ships. The lessons below were READ OFF the built pages' data-criteria, not asserted here, so this cannot drift from what is actually taught.
title: Mark out a joint
taughtBy: Marking Out and Cutting a Halving Joint

criteria.text: Work from the face side and face edge for every measurement, and never from a damaged or unprepared end.
Square a shoulder line across the face and down both edges with a try square, continuing the line without stepping.
criteria.evidence: Assessor sign-off; lines checked for step.

criteria.text: Set a marking gauge to a stated dimension and gauge the cheek lines from the face side on both members.
criteria.evidence: Gauge setting checked; marked stock inspected.

criteria.text: Mark the waste clearly on the correct side of every line before any cut is made.
